brief:
Israeli occupation forces demolished residential structures and animal husbandry facilities in the al-Ras al-Ahmar area southeast of Tubas on Tuesday, Shehab Wire reported. Bulldozers began systematic demolition operations targeting both housing units and infrastructure for livestock breeding in the Palestinian community located in the northern West Bank region.

The operation destroyed multiple residential buildings along with facilities used for animal husbandry, affecting the livelihoods of residents in the area. Al-Ras al-Ahmar lies in a zone frequently subject to Israeli military operations and settlement expansion pressures.
